description: T-3298: Excel's per-character case tables. Candidates are every scalar value whose Rust std (rustc 1.97) to_lowercase or to_uppercase differs from itself (3037 code points, BMP and supplementary). Data!A1:A50 hold the 1580 characters whose to_uppercase differs, ascending, 32 per cell; Calc!A = UPPER of each. Data!B1:B47 hold the 1488 characters whose to_lowercase differs, 32 per cell; Calc!B = LOWER of each. Data!D/E rows 1..1514 hold the 1514 one-to-one pairs (upper, lower) from either direction, sorted by upper; per block of 32 rows Calc!C = TEXTJOIN of MATCH(lower_i, uppers of the block, 0) (0 = no match, else the position in the block, so row i folding to its own pair reads i) and Calc!D the reverse MATCH(upper_i, lowers of the block, 0). Generated by a one-off script from Rust's tables (decoded in docs/excel-semantics/text.md).
